statement: A trader-signed EIP-712 trade intent was submitted to Desk.tradeWithSig by the Imprest relayer (relayer paid gas), filled on Perpl testnet, and the resulting position was confirmed on an independent RPC
methodology: Relayer simulated, then submitted with gas 698427; position lots read on the verification RPC at the receipt block (359) equal the TradeExecuted lotsAfter
